items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, the name I thought last night was Fincher... [INTERVIEWEE] I thought it was Tom something. I don't think it's a shame person. I don't know.

ctx.x: Somebody from Mineral Wells, what was that man's name? What was his name?
Well, the name I thought last night was Fincher. But he was around Asheville that he promoted the Crazy Water Crystals. But I never associated him with Mineral Wells.

I thought it was Tom something. I don't think it's a shame person. I don't know. Somebody who had stock or owned stock in Mineral Wells with Crazy Water Crystals in Mineral Wells, Texas. That's where the company first started and had its home office.
